fusions.name: Tucked Blade
fusions.desc: A hidden sting that deals 7 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and has a 50% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Between the Ribs
fusions.desc: Throws a hidden sting that deals 30 damage and always lands as a critical hit. Against an enemy that has not yet been wounded, it has +50% critical chance.

fusions.name: Out of Sight
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Twist After
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your next ability deals 25% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
